title: Polyglot adapter playground: Edge+Server templates and ergonomic SDK examples
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a compact, opinionated set of examples and templates demonstrating best-practice usage patterns for the Redwood SDKs across Next.js (edge/server), FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and a CLI. Focus areas: ergonomics for streaming responses, robust retry/backoff patterns, idempotency for at-least-once endpoints, and light production hygiene (Dockerfile, env config, local run). Deliverables: one repository-ready example per runtime, a short README per example with integration notes, and a short cross-language reference doc that highlights API shape parity and trade-offs.
tasks: Design API surface & folder layout for examples repo
Implement Next.js example (edge function streaming + server route fallback)
Implement FastAPI example demonstrating streaming chunk consumption and reconnect semantics
Implement Go HTTP server example with retries, context cancellation, and KV cache usage example
Implement CLI tool example (TypeScript/Node) showing batch embeddings, progress, and backoff
Write READMEs and 'Guides' section comparing SDK behaviors and recommended patterns
Add Dockerfile and simple deploy notes for each example
Create quick integration tests that run locally (smoke tests against local emulator or mock)
acceptance_criteria: Each example builds and runs locally with provided instructions
Streaming examples demonstrate resumable read semantics and expose minimal ergonomic APIs for consumers
Retry/backoff examples include exponential backoff with jitter and demonstrate idempotency key usage
Examples include a short guidance block on cost/latency trade-offs and recommended runtime configs
Docs include code snippets for Python, TypeScript, and Go that map to the same logical flow (chat -> streaming -> finalize)
